Detail: All scenarios parameters and pipelines are driven by YAML configs with environment overlays; no hardcoded values.
Validate configs and parameter ranges before compute; fail fast with clear errors.
No hardcoded paths or state; all inputs/outputs via args or env vars to support headless/batch use.
Analytics must be stateless and reproducible; same inputs yield same outputs suitable for REST and scripts.
Every analytic has contract tests and edge/fuzz coverage; tests live in tests/ with clear contracts.
Full type annotations with mypy-clean code; no unchecked Any without justification. Use Python 3.11+ syntax.
flake8 black isort must all pass; code style is automated and enforced.
Prefer immutable data structures and pure functions; minimize shared mutable state.
Use frozen=True for immutable configuration objects; no shared mutable state by default.
All reports/exports go to explicit target folders with unique names; no silent overwrites.
Never rely on implicit current working directory or hardcoded user-specific paths.
Use LibCST for all non-trivial code rewrites to preserve formatting comments and semantics.
Avoid AST + astunparse for refactors due to formatting and comment loss; use LibCST/Bowler/Rope instead.
Use Bowler (Meta/Facebook) for large-scale declarative refactoring with AST safety.
Rope for project-aware refactoring and IDE integration when needed; optional.
Maintain a complete versioned stdlib module list (3.10-3.14); do not rely solely on pkgutil.iter_modules().
Never write internal packages (analytics finance api config scenarios legacy etc.) into requirements.txt/pyproject.
Permanently blacklist: pyarrow legacy redis bare yaml. Use pyyaml and vetted versions instead.
Do not use git+https URLs in requirements or pyproject dependencies to avoid resolver and deployment issues.
Use a src/ package layout for new libraries; keep code under src/package_name with tests scripts docs at top level.
Ensure every package has an __init__.py ideally generated to re-export public APIs using LibCST-based symbol extraction.
Use v14 suffix for DutchBay modules: cashflow_v14.py debt_v14.py tax_v14.py (not v15 not no suffix).
No relative imports. Use: from analytics.fx.processor import FXProcessor (not from ..fx.processor)
Rewrite imports with LibCST transformer that preserves formatting and only alters targeted import nodes.
Use isort: stdlib - third-party - local. All imports alphabetized within groups.
Maintain modern Python .gitignore: venvs caches build artifacts IDE files logs project-specific noise.
Before and after major refactors create git checkpoints for easy rollback.
Use heredoc for multi-line commit messages: git commit -F- <<'EOF' ... EOF (avoids quote/emoji issues).
Never include emojis in git commit messages or shell commands. Use plain ASCII only. Emojis cause dquote>/parse errors.
All Python scripts must end with: # EOF (Go with the Flow standard).
Use typer for CLI scripts (type-hint native). Use @app.callback(invoke_without_command=True) for default command pattern.
NEVER use argparse. Too verbose too much boilerplate. Use typer or simple sys.argv instead.
For scripts with <5 flags simple sys.argv parsing acceptable: fast = '--fast' in sys.argv[1:]
click is acceptable (typer is built on it) but typer preferred for new code.
Run black on all Python code: black analytics/ finance/ scripts/
Run isort on all Python code: isort analytics/ finance/ scripts/
Type check with mypy in strict mode; all function signatures fully typed.
Use pytest for all tests. Fail fast on first error.

Do not change signatures of run_v14_pipeline; calculate_scenario_kpis; TornadoResult; MultiMetricTornadoResult or the run_full_pipeline CLI mode without an explicit versioned decision and lender impact assessment.
Any script that runs the v14 engine must call validate_config_for_v14 with validation_mode=strict before run_v14_pipeline; no silent defaults behind the guard.
run_full_pipeline.py must support the contract python run_full_pipeline.py --mode base --config <path>; this is the frozen lender CLI surface.
New analytics outputs must conform to or extend analytics/contracts_v14 dataclasses such as TornadoResult and MultiMetricTornadoResult; no ad hoc result shapes.
Use existing v14 analytics and finance contracts and types instead of inventing new ones; keep KPI and cashflow interfaces aligned with those contracts.
calculate_scenario_kpis must always be called with keyword arguments; annual_rows; debt_result; config; discount_rate to keep the interface explicit and stable.
Modules must be import safe; side effects are only allowed under if __name__ == '__main__' and tests must be able to import any module without triggering work.
For Typer and other CLIs; never call functions in default argument values; use module level constants for defaults so flake8 bugbear B008 does not trigger.
Do not leave undefined feature hooks or unused public functions; future hooks must be stubs that raise NotImplementedError or be removed until needed.
All new code; docstrings and logging must respect a hard target of 88 characters per line; long prose must be reflowed or split rather than deferred to cleanup.
Docstrings should be concise summary lines plus wrapped detail lines; avoid single monster lines that will trigger E501 or B950.
Logging and error messages must be split or concatenated so they fit within the line length rule; no ultra long f strings on a single line.
New code must not introduce unused imports or unused local variables; flake8 F401 and F841 are treated as author time bugs; not cleanup work.
No f strings without placeholders; where there is no interpolation use plain string literals rather than f prefix.
New code may not reference undefined names; if a deliberate forward reference is required it must be covered either by a stub implementation or an explicit noqa and registry entry.
New code must not use function calls in default argument values; especially in Typer options and arguments; use constants or factories instead.
E501 and B950 must be prevented at author time; especially in docstrings; comments and logging; long lines are a design smell; not a later cleanup task.
New or heavily modified modules must be written to pass mypy under the current project configuration; type ignore comments require justification.
Public functions; methods and dataclasses in analytics and finance must carry full type hints on parameters and return types; not partial or omitted.
Core test files such as v14 pipeline smoke; CLI smoke; metrics integration; export smoke and v14 lender suite must remain green; they define whether lender facing behaviour is safe.

ScenarioAnalytics.run must return summary_df and timeseries_df whose columns include scenario_name; project_irr; equity_irr; project_npv; equity_npv; min_dscr; dscr_min for summary and scenario_name; dscr for timeseries; tests lock these names.
v14 JSON kpis payload must expose project_npv; project_irr; equity_irr; equity_npv; min_dscr and dscr_min; dscr_min must numerically match min_dscr within tolerance.
The primary local pipeline runs black; isort; compileall; pytest; mypy and JSON export; Go with the Flow helpers orchestrate these steps without shell hacks.
Pre commit must run black; isort; flake8 and mypy on staged files; failing hooks block commits; new code is expected to be emit clean with respect to these tools.
Go with the Flow CI helper supports a fast mode that runs formatting; targeted tests and mypy on a specified set of files; developers are expected to use this before review.

For multi file changes; use gather scripts to collect violations into context files; generate explicit Python fix scripts; run them; then run flake8 and pytest before committing; no blind sed based surgery.
Bulk lint fixes operate on generated context such as violations_context or E501 context files; fixes are applied only where the context explicitly indicates; keeping edits auditable.
Some violations are intentionally deferred and tracked in a registry; automated fix passes must respect this registry and avoid changing lines that are marked as deferred.
When prompts say Go with the Flow; AI generated code must target passing black; isort; flake8 including bugbear and mypy on first generation; within the 88 char line rule.

AI must avoid unused imports; B008; F541 and F821 in new code; and must assume the v14 contracts are the canonical types for analytics and finance; lint or type failures are treated as defects to fix; not work for the human team.
For CLIs; analytics modules and tests; AI should default to the established project templates such as Typer based CLI pattern and ScenarioAnalytics patterns rather than ad hoc structures.
Core lender facing modules must be kept lint clean and type safe; experimental or research modules may carry limited deferred debt but must be clearly identified and isolated from critical CI paths.

Changes to scenario schema or validation rules must go through validate_config_for_v14 and associated tests; no silent widening or narrowing of required fields without schema guard updates and test revisions.

Multi file or multi line edits must be implemented via Python tooling and Go with the Flow scripts; direct ad hoc sed or awk edits against the repo are discouraged and should be followed only by black and full tests if ever used.

For a new or changed module the definition of done is: black clean; isort clean; flake8 clean for configured codes; mypy clean on target packages; tests green; and no entries added to the deferred violations registry unless explicitly agreed.
